classification: EVIDENCE-GRADED PUBLIC FUNDING RELATIONSHIPS; NO ENDORSEMENTS; NO REAL-TIME FINANCIAL INTELLIGENCE
methodology: Distinct lanes: Russian war financing and transfers supporting Russia; Ukrainian defensive assistance; civilian/reconstruction funding; financial intermediation; indirect market exposures; uncommitted prospects.
A historic confirmed transaction is NOT a verified current recurring flow. A multi-year allocation does NOT establish full disbursement.
SIPRI trend-indicator values are NOT currency. World Bank mobilized funds, EU loans, national aid and ERA financing may overlap: never sum raw amounts.
National finance budgets and commodity tax receipts do not establish tracing of a private purchaser payment directly to military expenditure.
Indirect trade exposure and potential partners must not be falsely categorized as war sponsors or sanction violators.
No automatic list of people, account numbers, bank routing data, sanctions screening or tactical military procurement. No private individual targeting.

profiles.title: Russian federal government war expenditure
profiles.description: State budget outlays fund Russian military operations; oil/gas taxes are one revenue stream.
profiles.amountOrMetric: Oil/gas revenue forecast ≈ RUB 1 trillion for October 2026; ≈20% of total government income; NOT a traced payment to a specific unit.
profiles.limits: Revenue is fungible; this is not an audited rupee-by-rupee war-spending ledger.
profiles.regenerativeAlternative: A ceasefire and verified cessation of aggression can reduce future outlays and civilian damage.
profiles.verifiedFor: documented relationship only; not a commitment to participate in the OS

profiles.title: Russian oil and gas tax receipts
profiles.description: Energy production and sales contribute tax revenue to the Russian treasury.
profiles.amountOrMetric: Reuters cited 2026 forecast 8.918 trillion roubles in oil/gas revenue; forecasts are not receipts.
profiles.limits: Does not show each purchaser intends to fund war or that every transaction is prohibited.
profiles.regenerativeAlternative: Lawful energy diversification and transparent sanctions enforcement can reduce risk exposure.
profiles.verifiedFor: documented relationship only; not a commitment to participate in the OS
